sources.original_mg52_policy_and_coefficients: Unchanged source as archived, no copy, monkeypatch or replay parameter override

metrics.frozen_actor_replay: Run original MG52 actor choose and observe_selected from immutable own selected original source public before/action/after/reward/terminated; no original Farama reset/step. Cold start only at start of each of the three source families and independent source roles; reset actor recent trace at beginning of each original seed episode, preserve within-family accrued memory.
metrics.read_only_intervention_diagnostics: Before original choose, use exact frozen original MG52 memory and original MG47 parent choose in an independent checkpoint-restored shadow actor (no mutation of live replay), then record parent proposed action and empirically credited left/right/forward values at this precise original own-selected decision. Never change selected source action.
metrics.sources_and_custody: Exact ZIP byte SHA256, both full original canonical source hashes, independent same-source outcome, 198 episode identities, 36,754 action denominator, all source event before/after and selected-chain SHA, true terminal original goals and original family/role published aggregates. Cold actor checkpoint hash after each episode must equal the original source checkpoint_sha256 and role prior/after source sample totals must match.
metrics.decision_stages: Count parent phase seek; parent proposed left/right/forward; exact mission target not public front; candidate alternative supported by >=2 prior source-selected context/action samples; estimated empirical credit greater than proposed; advantage >=0.5; source actor value_opportunities and overrides. Treat the last two as pre-frozen acceptance rules; report the gap rather than silently adjusting.
metrics.evidence_sparsity: Number of source-selected goal event steps, credit assignments, total compact public context/action keys, positive-credit keys, positive credit on steer actions0/1/2, per-family/episode distribution, and fraction of documented decision opportunities with no relevant positive credit.
metrics.context_compression: For each role/family track exact original public before-hashes mapped into the MG52 manually designed public context abstraction; report number of abstractions containing multiple distinct public hashes, with counts. This is public-state compression and possible perceptual aliasing, NOT verified shared physical position, policy belief collapse or causal proof.
metrics.eligibility_value_bins: For candidate alternatives supported by >=2 own-selected samples, report value advantages <=0, 0<advantage<0.25, 0.25<=advantage<0.5, >=0.5 against original parent proposed action. Count each on the original selected trajectory and label observational, no offline intervention with new actions.
metrics.diagnostic_policy: Do not choose a revised steering threshold, goal event weight, trace length or wider context based on this already-exposed DEV cohort. Do not infer counterfactual performance if a missed decision changed; only selected-source original consequences are known.
metrics.frozen_expected_baseline: Original MG52 positive goals 3/9 enabled and 3/9 disabled; original first-use science false; original changed decisions 0 enabled. If actual archive contradicts, fail closed rather than reclassify.
